scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
We need more materials to hold a Christmas party for the Singles Union Army!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
我们需要更多材料，才能为单身联盟军举办圣诞派对！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
Bring ^ff000010 Stolen Cookie, 10 Stolen Candy, and 10 Bag Of Selling Goods^000000 from those damn raccoons!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
去从那些该死的浣熊那里抢回^ff000010个被偷窃的饼干、10个被偷窃的糖果和10个出售用商品袋^000000！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
Did you kick the ass of the Raccoon Hooray team? Oh! You've brought all the items we need. We will be able to feel some Christmas mood with it!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
把浣熊欢腾队狠狠教训了一顿吧？
哦！东西全带齐了，这下终于能过个有圣诞气氛的节日了！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
I will take ALL the items you brought. For that, I'll give you an exclusive reward only for Singles Union Army. You-must-open-it-ALONE!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
你带来的东西，我会全部收下。
作为答谢，送你一份单身联盟军的专属奖励。

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
Seize the holiday!
Glory to the Singles Union Army! hihihi HAHAHAHA!!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
夺回这个节日！
荣耀属于单身联盟军！hihihi HAHAHAHA!!

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
You have a total of {0} couple breaking points.
Break up at least 5 couples and come back to me!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
你目前共有{0}点拆散情侣积分。
至少拆散5对情侣，再回来找我！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
Yes! You did it!! More and more are joining the Singles Union Army!! hihihi HAHAHA-HAK! Victory is ours!!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]

hihihi HAHAHA-HAK! 胜利属于我们！！

[Union Commander Cliff]

scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]

没了那些东西，圣诞节可就没气氛了。

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
It's time to punish them and reclaim the items for the Singles Union Army!!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
是时候惩罚他们，为单身联盟军夺回物品了！！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
^ff0000>10 Stolen Cookie, 10 Stolen Candy and 10 Bag Of Selling Goods^000000 should be enough for the party. Find the raccoons on field maps and dungeons!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
^ff0000>10个被偷窃的饼干、10个被偷窃的糖果和10个出售用商品袋^000000，应该够举办派对了。
去野外和地下城找那些浣熊！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
It doesn't matter if you brought more, I will take them ALL!!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
多带也没关系，我会全部收下！！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
Hey you!! Yes! You right there! You!!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
嘿，你！对，就是你！你！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
Let me ask you bluntly.
You must be single. I've got a feeling. Right?!??
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
我就直问了。
你肯定是单身，我有预感。
没错吧？！？

scripts.text: WHAT! I'm in a relationship!!
scripts.translation: 什么！我有对象！！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
What? ...in a relationship?!!

......
Damn you! Taste the wrath of the Singles Union Army!!!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
什么？...有对象？！！

...
可恶！尝尝单身联盟军的怒火吧！！！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
hihihi HAHAHA-HAK!
I knew it! First glance I can tell!
Don't underestimate me, I've been single all my life! hihihi HAHAHA-HAK!
My name is Union Commander Cliff!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
hihihi HAHAHA-HAK!
我就知道！一眼就看出来了！
别小看我，我可是单身了一辈子！hihihi HAHAHA-HAK!
我就是联盟指挥官克里夫！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
Anyway, this December, the day is coming....
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
Christmas songs everywhere, bright colored lights, pouring white snow, and couples seeing each other with smile on their faces...couples...COUPPPLEEES...!!!!

[联盟指挥官 克里夫]

情侣...情——侣——！！！！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
In the beginning was a celebration of the birth of our Lord! Then, why...how...when did it became a day for couples??!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
这本来是庆祝主诞生的节日！
为什么...怎么会...什么时候变成情侣的节日了？？！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
I can't stand this....
I will not forgive them for the happiness they bring only for themselves!!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
我受不了了...
只顾自己幸福的家伙，绝不原谅！！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
Christmas for couples?
No way! This Christmas will be a day for singles!!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
情侣的圣诞节？
没门！这个圣诞节将是单身者的节日！！

scripts.text:
[Union Commander Cliff]
However, I will need members to stand against them. Its name would be, Singles Union Army!!
scripts.translation:
[联盟指挥官 克里夫]
不过，想对抗他们，还得召集更多人。
我们的队伍就叫单身联盟军！！

hihihi HAHAHA-HAK!

hihihi HAHAHA-HAK!

scripts.text:
[Poor Alchemist]
Biologically speaking, limbic system in the cerebrum enables us to be sociable, to communicate with people, to entertain etc.
scripts.translation:
[落魄的炼金术士]
从生物学角度来说，大脑中的边缘系统让我们能够社交、与人交流、享受娱乐等。

scripts.text:
[Poor Alchemist]
So when you see a beautiful woman, the information such as her appearance, her scent, the tone of her voice etc. goes to the limbic area.
scripts.translation:
[落魄的炼金术士]
所以，看到一位美丽的女性时，她的外貌、气味、语调等信息，都会传到大脑的边缘区域。

scripts.text:
[Poor Alchemist]
The limbic system then evaluates the information, to see if this lady is friendly, agressive, or charming, etc.
scripts.translation:
[落魄的炼金术士]
边缘系统接着会评估这些信息，判断她是友善、有攻击性，还是很有魅力。

scripts.text:
[Poor Alchemist]
When the evaluation is done, the limbic system immediately begins to secrete the chemicals.
scripts.translation:
[落魄的炼金术士]
评估完成后，边缘系统会立即开始分泌化学物质。

scripts.text:
[Poor Alchemist]
So if you're attracted to this lady, a hormone calls Dopamine is secreted and it makes you feel slightly happy.
scripts.translation:
[落魄的炼金术士]
如果你被这位女士吸引，就会分泌一种名为多巴胺的激素，让你感到微微快乐。

scripts.text:
[Poor Alchemist]
When that stage ends, you get the Adrenaline pumping, then you become more direct and enthusiastic.
scripts.translation:
[落魄的炼金术士]
这个阶段结束后，肾上腺素开始涌动，让你变得更直接、更热情。

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

Umba~ Umba umba!
Umba umumumum!
scripts.translation:
[普雷内坦]
Umba~ Umba umba!
Umba umumumum!

scripts.text:
[Prenetan]
Finally got you, huh? You are cheating on me until now and even made me chase after you? I'll kill you boy!
scripts.translation:
[普雷内坦]
终于逮到你了！一直在外面拈花惹草，还让我追了这么久？
我要宰了你！

scripts.text:
[Umpoucoriotan]
Ooohh... my wife is too violent. Ohh...it hurts!
scripts.translation:

噢...我的妻子太暴力了。噢...好痛！

scripts.text:
[Umpoucoriotan]
Wenathan, berzthan, Chabimathan
Oooh... The girls of Umbala are here... They're waiting for me now....Arg! Don't touch me!
scripts.translation:
[乌姆波乌科里奥坦]
Wenathan, berzthan, Chabimathan
噢...汶巴拉的女孩们来了...她们现在正在等我...啊！别碰我！

scripts.text:
[Prenetan]
How stupid you are!
Those girls never wanted to see you and that's just a lie that they would come here!!
scripts.translation:
[普雷内坦]
你真蠢！
那些女孩根本不想见你，说她们会来这里都是骗你的！！

scripts.text: - No. They are all here!
scripts.translation: - 不。她们都在这里！

scripts.text:
[Umpoucoriotan]
Umm...yeah I know..Is it true those girls are here?
scripts.translation:
[乌姆波乌科里奥坦]
嗯...是，我知道...
那些女孩真的来了吗？

scripts.text:
[Umpoucoriotan]
...Oh I got a stomachache... Did I have something wrong... Darling, just a second. I'll be right back soon to go to the restroom! Just wait for a while here!
scripts.translation:
[乌姆波乌科里奥坦]
...哎呀，肚子疼...是不是吃坏东西了...
亲爱的，等一下，我去趟厕所马上回来！
你在这里等一会儿！

scripts.text:
[Prenetan]
Hey you idiot! Stop right there! Stop! ...STOP!!!
scripts.translation:
[普雷内坦]
你这个笨蛋！站住！停下！...停下！！！

scripts.text:
- Well, things are quite easy. Got 1 score point!

Who's there? You want to be killed, too?
scripts.translation:
[普雷内坦]
谁？你也想找死吗？

scripts.text: - Oops
scripts.translation: - 哎呀

scripts.text:
[Prenetan]
You still don't understand anything. Come here, I'm taking you back to Umbala!
scripts.translation:
[普雷内坦]
你还是什么都不懂。过来，我带你回汶巴拉！

scripts.text:
[Umpoucoriotan]
ARG! ....Arrrrrrrrg!! It hurts! Noooo!!! They're waiting for me!!!
scripts.translation:
[乌姆波乌科里奥坦]
ARG! ...Arrrrrrrrg!! 好痛！不要啊！！！她们还在等我！！！

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
Whahahahaha the world will turn into darkness soon and everyone will kneel down before me!!
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
Whahahahaha 世界很快就会陷入黑暗，所有人都将在我面前跪下！！

scripts.text:
[Succubus]
My master. All worlds will follow your will.
scripts.translation:
[梦魔]
我的主人。所有世界都将遵循您的意志。

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
Whahahahaha the world will turn into darkness soon and everyone will kneel down before me!!
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
Whahahahaha 世界很快就会陷入黑暗，所有人都将在我面前跪下！！

scripts.text:
[Succubus]
My master. All worlds will follow your will.
scripts.translation:
[梦魔]
我的主人。所有世界都将遵循您的意志。

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
You've been loyal to me even though I've been giving difficult orders. You deserve a reward. What do you want for now? I'll definitely make it for you. I can even give you more power!
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
我下过那么多难办的命令，你却始终忠心耿耿，理应获得奖励。
想要什么？我一定满足你，甚至可以赐予你更强的力量！

scripts.text:
[Succubus]
......
Could you really give me anything that I want...?
scripts.translation:
[梦魔]
...
我想要什么，您真的都会给吗...？

scripts.text:
[Succubus]
What I really need is...
......
Only you, my master.
scripts.translation:
[梦魔]
我真正想要的是...
...
只有您，主人。

scripts.text:
[Succubus]
I've been in love with you...
for a very long time...
scripts.translation:
[梦魔]
我一直爱着您...
已经很久了...

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
......
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
...

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
It's not that I didn't know about that.
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
我并不是不知道这件事。

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
I also...
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
我也...

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
...But we're demons. Demons choosing a path towards love?! Ridiculous, the dark world will never forgive us! We will be hiding for the rest of our lives!
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
...可我们是恶魔。恶魔竟然选择爱情？！荒唐！
黑暗世界绝不会原谅我们，我们只能躲藏一辈子！

scripts.text:
[Succubus]
It doesn't matter as long as I am with you, my master...
scripts.translation:
[梦魔]
只要能和您在一起，都没关系，主人...

scripts.text: - I'm sorry to bother you... but weren't you discussing about conquering the world?
scripts.translation: - 抱歉打扰一下...你们不是在讨论征服世界吗？

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
Ye..yes. That's right, succubus! We've already had such a high goal!
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
是...是啊。没错，梦魔！
我们可是有远大目标的！

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
I appreciated the thought but know your place! Just be my subordinate as you already are.
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
你的心意我领了，但别忘了自己的身份！
像现在这样，继续当我的部下就好。

scripts.text:
[Succubus]
Oh yes...my master, please forgive me. I'll try my best to make your the world yours.
scripts.translation:
[梦魔]
是...主人，请原谅我。
我会竭尽全力，让整个世界都属于您。

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
Yes! There is nothing better than turning this world into darkness. Everyone will kneel down before me. Hahahahahahahahah!!!
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
没错！让世界陷入黑暗，才是最美妙的事。
所有人都会跪在我面前。Hahahahahahahahah!!!

scripts.text:
- Even though the world will
- be engulfed in darkness soon...
- I got a big success to break up a couple!
- 2 score points!
- Current couple breaking point is {0}.
scripts.translation:
- 虽然世界即将被黑暗吞噬...
- 但成功拆散了一对情侣！
- 获得2分！
- 当前拆散情侣积分为{0}。

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
Conquering the world... It's useless compared to what we've feeling right now.
Dear Succubus, can you really overcome any kind of agony if you are with me?
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
征服世界...比起我们此刻的感情，根本不值一提。
亲爱的梦魔，只要和我在一起，你真的什么痛苦都能承受吗？

scripts.text:
[Succubus]
...Master!
scripts.translation:
[梦魔]
...主人！

scripts.text:
[Succubus]
Of course, I'm prepared and will keep going... I'll follow you forever even if I shall be in any kind of agony.
scripts.translation:
[梦魔]
当然，我已经做好准备，会一直走下去...
无论遭受怎样的痛苦，我都会永远追随您。

scripts.text:
[Succubus]
I'll be yours forever!
scripts.translation:
[梦魔]
我将永远属于您！

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
I see...I can feel your heart now. Ok, let's go together... no matter how hard it will be!!
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
我明白了...现在能感受到你的心意了。
好，一起走吧...不管有多艰难！！
